title: College refusing to issue tuition fee receipts to students
description: College collects cash fees but refuses to issue computerized receipts. Students have no proof of payment for tax and scholarship purposes.

title: Forced payment of alumni association membership fees
description: First year students are being compelled to pay alumni association membership fees that are not part of the official fee structure.

title: Double charging of examination fees despite online payment confirmation
description: College charged examination fees twice from students who had already paid online. Refund of duplicate payment has been denied for months.

title: Penalty charges for withdrawal of admission within legal period
description: College is deducting 70 percent of paid fees when students withdraw admission within the legally permissible refund window.

title: Unjustified hostel fee hike without parent notification
description: Hostel charges were unilaterally increased by thirty percent mid-year without informing parents or students at the time of admission.

title: Mandatory insurance fee collected without policy documents
description: Students are charged annual insurance premium but never receive any insurance policy documents or coverage details.

title: Charging illegal processing fee for government scholarship applications
description: Institute demands processing charges from scholarship applicants to forward their applications to the state scholarship portal.

title: Library fee collected without providing functional library access
description: Annual library charges are collected from every student but library is closed on most weekdays and lacks required textbooks.

title: Collecting unauthorized technology enhancement fee
description: College levies an unapproved technology fee under the guise of digital infrastructure without regulatory authority approval.

title: Fake faculty listed in official AICTE compliance portal
description: College management uploaded photographs and credentials of nonexistent ghost faculty to show compliance with faculty norms during AICTE inspection.

title: Faculty moonlighting and absent from campus during official duty hours
description: Department HOD is absent from college more than half the week running a private tuition center while drawing full government salary.

title: No faculty member available for practical lab supervision
description: Laboratory practicals are conducted without any qualified faculty present. Students are left alone in the lab with dangerous equipment.

title: College principal lacks required academic qualifications
description: The principal of the engineering college holds only a bachelors degree and does not meet the mandatory PhD requirement for the post.

title: Faculty not following prescribed lecture delivery schedule
description: Teachers are not completing the course syllabus. They spend lecture hours reading from textbooks without engaging students.

title: Teaching staff forced to sign blank attendance registers
description: College management asks teachers to sign blank attendance records to show complete attendance without faculty physically being present.

title: No staff meeting or academic review conducted throughout semester
description: College does not hold departmental review meetings and has no mechanism to monitor or improve teaching quality.

title: Faculty denied maternity and medical leave benefits
description: Female teaching staff were denied mandatory maternity leave and threatened with pay cuts for taking sick leave.

title: Use of unqualified students as teaching assistants for core subjects
description: Toppers from senior batches are deployed to teach full subjects to junior batches instead of qualified faculty members.

title: Visiting faculty replacing permanent faculty for entire academic year
description: All three core engineering subjects have been taught entirely by visiting lecturers without a single permanent faculty appointment.

title: Engineering college offering course without AICTE statutory approval
description: Institute launched BTech Cybersecurity program and enrolled 90 students without obtaining any letter of approval from AICTE.

title: Private institution issuing degrees not affiliated with any statutory university
description: College is awarding MBA degrees without university affiliation claiming autonomous body status without regulatory recognition.

title: College conducting technical program beyond sanctioned seat count
description: Institute expanded BTech seats by 120 without applying for increased intake approval from AICTE or state government.

title: Online engineering degree offered without UGC or AICTE distance learning approval
description: Website advertises a fully online BTech Electronics program without online education approval from either UGC or AICTE.

title: Polytechnic offering diploma programs after losing AICTE recognition
description: Institute whose recognition was withdrawn last year due to multiple deficiencies is still admitting new diploma students this year.

title: Degree course started without minimum infrastructure readiness
description: New college admitted students for BTech Civil Engineering without completing building construction or obtaining occupancy certificate.

title: Unapproved twinning arrangement with overseas university announced publicly
description: College officially announced a twinning arrangement with a foreign university without AICTE foreign collaboration approval.

title: Fake NAAC accreditation grade displayed on admission portal
description: College is falsely displaying NAAC A grade accreditation on their portal despite never having been assessed or accredited.

title: Vocational course certificates sold without conducting actual training
description: Certificate mill is selling NSQF vocational diploma certificates online without conducting any training or assessment.

title: Short-term engineering certification course claiming AICTE recognition
description: A private startup is selling 6-month engineering certification courses falsely claiming equivalence with AICTE approved diplomas.

title: Admissions made through forged affiliation letter from affiliating university
description: College obtained new admissions by showing a fabricated university affiliation letter that was never issued by the stated university.

title: Fake domicile certificate used for obtaining reserved category engineering seat
description: A candidate from another state submitted a forged state domicile certificate to illegally secure a local reserved category engineering seat.

title: Mass irregular admissions during special round without eligibility verification
description: College admitted 200 candidates in a special admission drive without verifying their JEE scores or eligibility certificates.

title: Admission denied to eligible differently abled candidate
description: Candidate with benchmark disability was refused admission despite qualifying all state merit round cutoffs and eligibility norms.

title: NRI quota admission taken by non-NRI paying inflated fee
description: Domestic students with no NRI status were admitted to NRI quota seats by paying five times the standard tuition.

title: College not following state reservation policy for OBC students
description: OBC category candidates are not getting seats in the reserved quota as the college is filling those seats with general category students.

title: Student forced to take branch not applied for during counseling
description: Candidate who applied for CSE was forcefully allotted to Mechanical engineering claiming CSE was full at the time of joining.

title: Cancellation of merit seat after student paid first semester fee
description: Student who had paid admission fee after state merit allotment had admission cancelled without refund or alternate offer.

title: Private college insisting on direct bank payment bypassing fee portal
description: Admission cell is collecting seat confirmation amounts through personal bank accounts instead of the government payment portal.

title: Lateral entry admission to diploma given without qualifying the eligibility test
description: Students were admitted to lateral entry second year diploma without having appeared in the lateral entry entrance test.

title: Seats allotted to candidates below minimum qualifying percentage
description: Institute enrolled students who scored below the minimum qualifying marks in the qualifying examination for the program.

title: Degree certificate not issued 3 years after course completion
description: A student who completed BTech in 2022 has still not received official degree certificate due to unresolved administrative issues at the university.

title: Provisional certificate not issued despite fee payment for certificate
description: Student paid the prescribed certificate fee six months ago but the institution has not dispatched the provisional degree certificate.

title: Grade transcript not updated after re-evaluation result declared
description: University declared re-evaluation result changing grade from F to B but the official grade transcript has not been updated for 9 months.

title: Original documents withheld under pretext of pending dues
description: College is refusing to release migration certificate citing minor dues dispute that has already been resolved through a written complaint.

title: Delay in processing migration certificate for higher education abroad
description: Student needs a migration certificate to submit university application abroad but certificate office has delayed for 5 months.

title: No mechanism to track pending certificate application status
description: University provides no tracking system for certificate applications. Students have no visibility or timeline for when documents will be ready.

title: Certificate issued with incorrect CGPA not matching marksheet
description: The official degree certificate shows a CGPA of 7.1 while consolidated marksheet shows 8.3 causing rejection by employers.

title: Marksheet not generated for distance education students
description: Open university students who passed all papers five months ago have not received any marksheets affecting their employment prospects.

title: University charging hidden fee to expedite degree certificate issuance
description: University staff are informally demanding payment to expedite processing of degree certificates that should be issued within 30 days.

title: Degree certificate delay causing job offer withdrawal by employer
description: A company withdrew its job offer from a student because the university could not deliver degree certificate within the joining deadline.

title: AICTE model curriculum not implemented in BE Civil Engineering
description: The engineering college continues to use an outdated 2015 curriculum without adopting the AICTE 2022 model curriculum guidelines.

title: No internship credit awarded for mandatory industry training
description: Students completed mandatory 6-month industry internship but the college refused to award the prescribed curriculum internship credits.

title: Syllabus not reviewed for 10 years in legacy courses
description: Electrical Engineering department is running a 2009 era syllabus without any revision despite drastic changes in the field and AICTE recommendations.

title: Arbitrary subject added to syllabus one week before exam
description: Department added a new elective subject to the evaluation scheme one week before semester exams without giving students time to prepare.

title: Online MOOC credits not recognized despite AICTE recommendation
description: Student completed UGC and AICTE approved SWAYAM online courses but college refuses to give credit transfer as per NEP norms.

title: Practical exposure missing from software engineering curriculum
description: The BE Computer Science course has no practical coding lab sessions. All lab hours are theoretical lectures with no compiler access.

title: No industry expert lectures as mandated by AICTE guidelines
description: Institute does not invite any industry professionals or expert guest lecturers as mandated in the AICTE model curriculum framework.

title: Curriculum designed without academic council or Board of Studies
description: College designed its own syllabus for a new course without constituting a Board of Studies or getting academic council approval.

title: Faculty not following credit hour distribution in course delivery
description: Teachers are completing 4-credit subjects in 2 weeks leaving other courses untouched resulting in incomplete curriculum delivery.

title: Assessment pattern not aligned with stated learning outcomes
description: Internal and external exam question patterns do not match the published course learning outcomes and AICTE program outcomes.

title: Sexual harassment complaint against professor not investigated
description: A student filed a written sexual harassment complaint against a male professor 6 months ago. Neither ICC nor management has taken any action.

title: College administration covering up ragging after formal complaint
description: Student submitted a formal ragging complaint. Instead of action against the accused seniors, the administration pressured the victim to withdraw the complaint.

title: Seniors assaulting juniors physically in hostel room at night
description: A group of senior hostel students entered first-year rooms at midnight and physically assaulted juniors who refused to follow orders.

title: Gender discrimination in award of internal marks by faculty
description: Female students consistently receive lower internal assessment marks compared to male peers with identical performance without any academic justification.

title: Ragging during field trip and college industrial visit
description: Senior students harassed and humiliated junior students during a mandatory industrial visit to the factory. No faculty supervision was present.

title: Hostel warden verbally abusing students and using offensive language
description: The girls hostel warden regularly uses abusive and demeaning language with students and threatens to rusticate those who complain.

title: Anonymous threatening messages sent to student who reported ragging
description: After a student filed a ragging complaint the victim started receiving anonymous threatening messages to withdraw the complaint immediately.

title: Group bullying of minority community student by classmates
description: A student from a religious minority community is being systematically excluded and bullied by classmates with derogatory comments about religion.

title: College has no gender sensitization program or trained ICC members
description: The college has not conducted any gender sensitization training and the ICC members have no training on POSH Act procedures.

title: Seniors blocking access to academic resources for junior students
description: Seniors are preventing juniors from using library terminals and study rooms through systematic intimidation and threats.

title: PMKVY training batch attendance manipulated to claim subsidy
description: Training center submitted fake attendance records to the government to illegally claim PMKVY skill development subsidy for trainees who never attended.

title: Skill development stipend deducted by training center without authority
description: Skill training institution deducted 40 percent of government-issued stipend amounts from candidates under fake administrative charges.

title: No competent assessor available for skill certification examination
description: The skill certification assessment was conducted by an unregistered assessor without valid sector skill council authorization.

title: Skill training center closed permanently without informing enrolled trainees
description: Trainees paid fees for a 6-month skill course but the center shut down after one month without refunding fees or completing training.

title: NATS portal registration rejected without valid technical reason
description: Engineering graduates trying to register on the NATS apprenticeship portal are being repeatedly rejected due to unexplained portal errors.

title: Skill certification course conducted without required lab equipment
description: A plumbing skills course was conducted without any practical tools or lab equipment making it impossible for trainees to learn hands-on skills.

title: Delay in upload of practical assessment result on government portal
description: Assessment agency conducted practical exams 4 months ago but results have not been uploaded on the NSDC portal affecting candidates.

title: Industry trainer conducting skill course without valid certification
description: A coding bootcamp under a skill scheme is being conducted by a trainer who has no technical qualification or industry certification.

title: Government scholarships for skill trainees disbursed to wrong accounts
description: Scholarship amounts under a central skill scheme were credited to accounts other than the enrolled students due to data entry errors.

title: Skill institute charging extra coaching fee for guaranteed certification
description: Institute is illegally charging candidates additional money guaranteeing skill assessment pass results in advance of the exam.
